modelingNotes: Exact Murrelektronik article85064; historic source manufacturer Murr is preserved. Manufacturer exact-product diagram establishes 1=PE,2=N,3=L,4=DC− and5=DC+. Diagram numbers are retained rather than connector-local table indices.

Adjustable output and universal/variable input are capability ranges. No input/output nominal_voltage or conditional current scalar is assigned. Output ratings are total supply capability, not independent allowances on duplicate clamps. Project intent must specify the chosen supply voltage.

Input pins1/2/3 are required for the powered abstraction. Output connections are application-dependent. No field bond to DC return is invented. The device outline is not a wire; function membership never creates net continuity.

Five field terminals, no duplicate output clamps. Exact diagram and inventory show no additional signal/communication/PE interface; output indication and adjuster are not signal terminals. No permanent terminal-to-terminal links are asserted.

Historical exact sheet input90–265 VAC /110–300 VDC; output24 VDC nominal, adjustable20–30 V;2.5 A at+60°C or3 A at+50°C. Conditional capabilities remain documentation. DC-input connection polarity is not established by the power-interface diagram.

Clamp technology and installed manufacturing revision must be checked against the physical device; exact current diagrams do not prove every historical unit revision. No housing/mounting bond path is inferred from metalwork.

connectionCoverage.notes: All five terminals of the manufacturer circuit diagram are inventoried: input L/N/PE (3/2/1) and isolated DC output DC+/DC- (5/4). This article has no signal/relay contact (green LED only) and no repeated output clamps, so the physical connection inventory is complete. Terminal clamp technology/conductor range and any internal DC-/PE relationship are not detailed by this datasheet.

1.description: Protective earth input PE (earth symbol on diagram)

2.description: AC neutral input N (universal wide input; see notes for range)

3.description: AC line input L (universal wide input; see notes for range)

4.description: DC output negative/return DC- (24 V DC nominal, SELV)

5.description: DC output positive DC+ (24 V DC nominal, SELV; 20-30 V adjustable per notes)
